tutorial.info: Here you'll see the deal number, the pot, the current stake, and each player's chips and status (Blind / Seen / Folded / Out). Teen Patti is the Indian variant of Three Card Brag, a 4-player vying game played with a 52-card deck and 3 cards each.
tutorial.players: Each player's chip balance and status. Lose all your chips and you're eliminated; the last player with chips wins the match.
tutorial.hand: Your 3 cards. Looking at your hand (See) turns you from Blind to Seen, after which your bets cost double. Hand ranking is Trail > Pure Sequence > Sequence > Color > Pair > High Card.
tutorial.bet: On your turn choose See (look at your hand), Bet (call the stake), Raise (increase the stake), or Fold. A Seen player can request a Side Show (a private hand comparison) with the previous Seen player, who then accepts or declines. When two players remain you can Show to force a showdown.
tutorial.sideShow: When a Side Show is requested, this highlighted panel shows the request. If you are the target, respond with the Accept / Decline buttons inside the panel.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game and start over from the beginning.
